description.zh:
本次调用期望查询的最大条目数。可配合NextToken参数一起使用。

取值范围：1~500。

默认值：10。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries to be returned. You can use this parameter together with NextToken.

Valid values: 1 to 500.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的NextToken参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数。如果设置了NextToken，则请求参数PageSize和PageNumber将失效，且返回数据中的TotalCount无效。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous call to the DescribeDiskReplicaPairs operation. Leave this parameter empty the first time you call this operation. When you specify NextToken, the PageSize and PageNumber request parameters do not take effect and the TotalCount response parameter is invalid.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。 取值范围1-100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

description.zh: 复制对ID。您可以通过[DescribeDiskReplicaPairs](~~354206~~)接口查询异步复制对列表，获得复制对ID入参的值。
description.en: The ID of the replication pair. You can call the [DescribeDiskReplicaPairs](~~354206~~) operation to query a list of asynchronous replication pairs, including replication pair IDs.

description.zh: 异步复制对中主盘或从盘所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~354276~~)查询异步复制功能支持的地域信息。
description.en: The region ID of the primary or secondary disk in the async replication pair. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~354276~~) operation to query the most recent list of regions in which async replication is supported.

title.zh: 查询复制对当前的容灾演练

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs describe-pair-drills --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --drill-id drill-xxxx --pair-id pair-xxxx --max-results 10 --next-token AAAAAdDWBF20000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
